# El Fortín

> Ten deeded apartments in Riba-roja de Túria, Valencia. You take title. We operate the building.

El Fortín Construcciones y Patrimonio S.L. (CIF B22792923) is selling remaining apartments at Camino Valencia 31, 46190 Riba-roja de Túria, Valencia, Spain. Each buyer takes title (escritura) to a named apartment. Rent from all ten is pooled. A 4% yearly return, net of the apartment sale price (valor público), is guaranteed in the contract; if operations fall short, the company pays the difference. Mixed operations are projected at 7%, with 10% upside after reviews. Those projections are not a promise. Construction is 25% complete. Operations begin August 2027. Building licence Exp. 4497/2025/GEN, granted 20 October 2025. One-bedroom from €236,000; two-bedroom from €270,000, appliances and furniture included. Nine of ten apartments remain. Founder and operator: Uriel Nabel, who lives in Riba-roja.
